input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research programme hanger-codesign (pick_track draw): milestone 3e, registered pooled cross-mesh lowest-energy rule on one solver
errors: Container restart killed the first phase-1 launch about 20 min in; no checkpoints yet, work lost.

Checkpoint bug of my own: Path.with_suffix on 'partial_A_1.875_0' gives 'partial_A_1.json', so all seeds on a lattice shared one checkpoint and the A 1.875 mm seed 1 to 6 chains resumed from seed 0's state. Caught from the log (a chain printed EA 254 with no EA 150 line), killed, discarded every chain a resume could have touched, fixed with string-built names and atomic writes, added a resume-exactness test; about 25 more minutes lost.
test_m3e failed only in the full suite (each milestone has a run.py, so `import run` picked up another test's module); fixed by pinning 3a's module while loading, as test_m3d does.

doc_friction.issue: wait_for.py on a log returns at once if the log already holds an earlier phase's DONE line; appending a second phase to the same log made two 10-minute waits return instantly. Worth one line: use --pid or --until for multi-phase logs.

The 2 h background-job cap plus the harness note 'if it already had the longest timeout, do not restart it' fit badly with multi-hour resumable experiments; a sentence on making long jobs resumable (per-stage checkpoints) and resuming bounded remaining work would save the next run from guessing.

deviations.why: Both phases hit the 2 h background cap; the note says not to restart a job that already had the longest timeout. The job was resumable from cached stages/transfers and the remaining work was bounded (3 short chains; 47 transfers, about 1.5 h).
deviations.did: Resumed each phase once from its cache, logged in run_log.txt.
deviations.result: Both finished; resume exactness is tested (test_m3e).

deviations.why: To save about 110 core-minutes, the 1.875 mm suiting reran seeds 0 to 2 only, taking 3d's seeds 3 to 6 (identical-energy twins), conditional on T1 holding.
deviations.did: Declared in the docstring before the run.
deviations.result: T1 held 24 of 24 with zero energy difference, so the substitution is exact.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
